patterns.what_worked: Enumerating the compat surface first (61 named entries) and then scanning bare globals alias-aware gave a complete call graph; dumping only the relevant generated API docs and parsing each function block for SecretWhen*/SecretArguments/aSpects produced exact branch:path:line citations for every row. Reading the landed fix desks' journals and bench reports first avoided re-deriving the power pass-through and kept the matrix on the settled tree.
patterns.what_was_hard: The product tree changed under the audit (10 files modified by three fix desks, version fields 2.1.7 -> 2.1.8 -> 2.2.0 uncommitted), so every addon line number had to be re-read after the fixes landed; and the secret regime is runtime state that no source tree can instantiate, so the predicate map is documented but the trigger context stays client-only (marked UNVERIFIED with exact /st diag and /run probes).
patterns.skill_gap: None for this lane. One trap worth recording: a source scan for 'api.GetSpellCooldown call sites' must exclude comment/needs strings and count per file, otherwise the total drifts (verified 28 real sites, not the ~70 in the dispatch estimate).
